description: Which Imagenette (imagenette2-160) files form the train / val / hidden-test splits of this experiment.
source: imagenette2-160 (https://github.com/fastai/imagenette): train and val come from imagenette2-160/train/<wnid>/, hidden_test from imagenette2-160/val/<wnid>/
procedure: For each class: list train/<wnid>/*.JPEG (resp. val/<wnid>/*.JPEG) of imagenette2-160, sort lexicographically, shuffle with a fresh random.Random(20261103), keep the first 100 (resp. 200). Of the 100 train-folder files, the first 50 went to train and the last 50 to val; the 200 val-folder files are the hidden test set. Five church val images were later moved to train (an earlier protocol let the agent view val images and moved each viewed image to train), giving the 505 / 495 split used by this run and by the teacher. The lists below are the authoritative membership; sha256 is given for train and val.
